radiusSource: Radius 71.1 +/- 4.8 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, Y Sct: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 71.1 +/- 4.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 49,464,270 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
